working_definition: Gland cluster labelled with the male accessory gland (authors' term FBbt:00004959, a structure composed of binucleate main and secondary cells), found in body, fat body and gut analyses.
searches_performed: semen-secreting cell of the male accessory gland

best_match.fbbt_term: semen-secreting cell of the male accessory gland
best_match.fbbt_definition: Any semen-secreting cell of the male reproductive system (FBbt:00058293) that is part of some male accessory gland (FBbt:00004959).

justification: The authors' term is the gland (structure). The cell-level equivalent is the common parent of the gland's two cell types (main cell FBbt:00004960 and secondary cell FBbt:00004961), both direct children of this term.
